description: This file defines types, events, and functions related to diagnostic event handling in a system, including event emission, listener management, and internal state management.

methods.name: getDiagnosticEventsState
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the global state object for diagnostic events, including sequence number, listeners, and dispatch depth.

methods.name: isDiagnosticsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if diagnostics are enabled based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: emitDiagnosticEvent
methods.description: Emits a diagnostic event, enriching it with sequence number and timestamp, and dispatches it to all registered listeners with recursion guard.

methods.name: onDiagnosticEvent
methods.description: Registers a listener for diagnostic events and returns a function to deregister it.

methods.name: resetDiagnosticEventsForTest
methods.description: Resets the diagnostic event state for testing purposes.
